changeSet.author: bquinlivan
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionAssetDataProfile') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionAssetDataProfile]( [ExecutionID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ItemNumber] [int] NOT NULL, [Success] bit NULL, [Message] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, [ExecutionItemUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [AssetUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ProfileSetDate] DATE NOT NULL, [SampleCount] BIGINT NULL, [NullCount] BIGINT NULL, [BlankCount] BIGINT NULL, [MeanValue] FLOAT NULL, [MinimumValue] NVARCHAR(500) NULL, [MaximumValue] NVARCHAR(500) NULL, [MinimumLength] INT NULL, [MaximumLength] INT NULL, [StandardDeviation] FLOAT NULL, [Multiline] BIT NULL, [RegExp] NVARCHAR(200) NULL, [Confidence] DECIMAL(28,4) NULL, [TypeQualifier] NVARCHAR(200) NULL, [Type] NVARCHAR(200) NULL, [LogicalType] BIT NULL, [LeadingWhiteSpace] BIT NULL, [LeadingZeroCount] INT NULL, [TrailingWhiteSpace] BIT NULL, [MatchCount] BIGINT NULL, [OutlierCardinality] INT NULL, [PossibleKey] BIT NULL, [DataSignature] NVARCHAR(200) NULL, [StructureSignature] NVARCHAR(200) NULL, [Cardinality] INT NULL, [ShapeCardinality] INT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ExecutionAssetDataProfile] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] ASC, [ItemNumber] ASC )WITH (STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF, IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF) ON [PRIMARY] ) ON [PRIMARY] END
IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[ExecutionAssetDataProfile]') AND name = 'DistinctValues' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [api].[ExecutionAssetDataProfile] DROP COLUMN [DistinctValues] END
IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[ExecutionAssetDataProfile]') AND name = 'JavaType' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [api].[ExecutionAssetDataProfile] DROP COLUMN [JavaType] END
IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[ExecutionAssetDataProfile]') AND name = 'PrimaryKey' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [api].[ExecutionAssetDataProfile] DROP COLUMN [PrimaryKey] END
IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[ExecutionAssetDataProfile]') AND name = 'NewType' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [api].[ExecutionAssetDataProfile] DROP COLUMN [NewType] END
IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[ExecutionAssetDataProfile]') AND name = 'CurrentType' ) BEGIN EXEC sp_rename 'api.ExecutionAssetDataProfile.CurrentType', 'Type', 'COLUMN'; END
IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[ExecutionAssetDataProfile]') AND name = 'Validation' ) BEGIN EXEC sp_rename 'api.ExecutionAssetDataProfile.Validation', 'RegExp', 'COLUMN'; END
IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[ExecutionAssetDataProfile]') AND name = 'TotalCount' ) BEGIN EXEC sp_rename 'api.ExecutionAssetDataProfile.TotalCount', 'SampleCount', 'COLUMN'; END
ALTER table api.ExecutionAssetDataProfile ALTER COLUMN [RegExp] NVARCHAR(MAX);
ALTER table api.ExecutionAssetDataProfile ALTER COLUMN [MeanValue] FLOAT;
ALTER table api.ExecutionAssetDataProfile ALTER COLUMN [StandardDeviation] FLOAT;
